take_homes: What you tell the AI first changes all its later answers. If I say I am an operations director, I get different answers.
The AI is too kind about its own work, so I check it against what I know myself.
The AI can keep a rules file and read it next time. That could be a depot report, if someone sets it up.

misconception.why: I still think of AI as a customer chatbot, but the context examples showed it also gives different answers depending on who I say I am. The exercise was about a LinkedIn website, though, so I did not see an operations use. Only the 'bring a real work problem' part came near it.

one_line: The context idea at the start is good, but half the pages are the same filler paragraph and the exercise is a personal website, not something for operations.
